task_completion.description: Start a new project using the 'Photovoltaic (detailed)' performance model.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The SAM 'Choose a model' window showing 'Photovoltaic (detailed)' selected and a financial model (e.g., 'No Financial Model' or 'Residential') chosen to enter the main interface.

task_completion.description: Set the location to Phoenix, AZ in the Location and Resource menu.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Location and Resource' page showing 'Phoenix' or a Phoenix-based weather file (TMY3 or similar) selected in the library.

task_completion.description: Configure the system to use bifacial modules.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the 'Module' or 'System Design' page, the 'Bifacial' checkbox is checked or a bifacial module is selected from the library.

task_completion.description: Set the system capacity to approximately 2,000 kWdc (2 MW).
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'System Design' page showing 'Desired array size' or 'Nameplate capacity' set to a value between 1800 and 2200 kWdc.

task_completion.description: Set tracking to 1-axis and Ground Coverage Ratio (GCR) to 0.20.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'System Design' page showing '1-axis tracking' selected and the 'GCR' or 'Ground coverage ratio' input field set to 0.20.

task_completion.description: Set the ground clearance height to 3.0 meters.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'System Design' or 'Shading and Layout' page showing 'Ground clearance' or 'Array height' set to 3.0 m.

task_completion.description: Save the project file as 'agrivoltaic.sam' in the specified directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The SAM title bar or a 'Save As' dialog box showing the path '/home/ga/Documents/SAM_Projects/agrivoltaic.sam'.

integrity.description: Verify the agent used the SAM GUI rather than just creating a file via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots must show the SAM application window being interacted with (clicking buttons, typing in fields) rather than just a terminal window.

integrity.description: Verify the agent manually entered the specific values (0.20, 3.0, 2000) into the SAM interface.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the cursor in the specific input fields for GCR, clearance, and capacity with the correct values typed in.

integrity.description: Verify the agent didn't simply open an existing file named agrivoltaic.sam.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory should show the 'New Project' workflow and the step-by-step configuration of parameters.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The system must be 'Photovoltaic (detailed)'. Location: Phoenix, AZ. Capacity: 1800-2200 kWdc. Module: Bifacial. Tracking: 1-axis (Tracking Mode 1). GCR: 0.20. Ground Clearance: 3.0 meters. File path: /home/ga/Documents/SAM_Projects/agrivoltaic.sam.
